reason: Under the transfer/leakage lens the idea has one real strength and several unresolved problems. I cannot confirm that it survives. STRENGTH: the refined end-only resmooth changes positions only, so N_pred and the edge set are identical and the node multiplier is exactly 1.000. The node-count trap is excluded if the replay asserts it. The rounding is also not an artefact: replay.write_geff rounds to integer voxels exactly like the submission writer (replay.py L626-634), so any local gain is measured on shipped-style coordinates. PROBLEMS. (1) The gain is conditional on the edge filter. The main mechanism (rs0) removes smoothing along relink edges that the edge filter later drops. Without the filter, rs0 is close to a no-op. The filter's +0.0162 (confirmation; 44b6 +0.0145, 6bba +0.0169) is still unconfirmed on the LB (probes 29/30 pending), and three relink-stage changes that looked good locally all landed at 0.945 on LB. (2) There is an in-sample channel. rs0 re-smooths ALONG the ILP re-links that replace the dropped edges (confirmation: 17,860 fwd + 8,609 bwd). Those links come from the edge net and ILP, both trained on all 199 videos. The re-link part is ~30% of the filter gain (selection: ef_a3 drop-only +0.0102 vs ef_a3_rl +0.0144). Locally those links are optimistically correct, so smoothing along them is optimistically helpful. On unseen embryos the same smoothing pulls nodes toward wrong partners. (3) The 44b6 gate cannot honestly be reached. If ALL 353 a_linefit FN were rescued with no new losses, the ceiling is 44b6 +0.0013 (28 FN in only 13/71 videos, GT-weighted, from ef_a3_rl_pr per-video TP/FP/FN), 6bba +0.0027, and +0.0025 overall. With the median move of 1.3 um at the 7-um boundary, a realistic 20-40% rescue gives 44b6 +0.0003-0.0005 (< the +0.001 gate), and the 55% win rate is impossible (at most 13/71 videos). Any 44b6 pass would also be pseudo-replicated: 44b6 is overlapping crops of one recording, so the video-level bootstrap overstates confidence. (4) It cannot be checked on the LB. Probes 20-25 spread 0.945-0.947 on identical-quality stacks (noise floor about +-0.002, 3-decimal display), and the expected +0.0005-0.002 sits below that floor. The only evidence would be the lab, which (2) biases. (5) The coordinate regime differs. The likely ship is exp51 (x138 float coordhead, ready). The lab tunes lambda on the integer 1.625-um detector grid, whose 0.47-um quantisation noise the head largely removes, so the chosen lambda will over-smooth on the shipped stack. The in-sample detector also biases the other way: local residual noise is lower than on unseen embryos, which pushes the lab toward too-weak smoothing (B28: weaker smoothing already loses, w0.5 -0.0053, win1 -0.0094). The per-axis z lambda is largely erased at output, because z is rounded to the 1.625-um voxel.
fix_if_any: Keep it only as a rider on the edge filter, with these conditions. (a) Run it only if probe 29/30 shows the edge filter transfers; otherwise drop it. (b) Add a leakage-control arm, wh_l2_cutILP: cut segments at BOTH unscored (edge_prob 0/None) edges AND at edges the filter re-linked from the ILP. That arm is network-free. Adopt rs0/rs2 only if the cutILP arm keeps >= 70% of their gain; otherwise the gain is in-sample ILP trust. (c) Gate: 6bba confirmation >= +0.001 with CI > 0, and 44b6 non-negative (>= -0.0002) with a bootstrap blocked by leak group (crop groups), not per video. Waive the 44b6 win rate, since it is unreachable by construction. Assert that the multiplier == 1.000000 and the edge sets are identical to the control. (d) Break lambda ties toward STRONGER smoothing (never pick wh_l1 over wh_l2 unless it wins by > 0.0005 on both embryos), which offsets the in-sample-detector bias. (e) Drop the z/xy lambda-ratio arms: z is rounded to 1.625 um at output. (f) If exp51 (coordhead) is the ship candidate, re-run rs1/wh_l2/wh_l3 on float-coordinate captures before bundling. Otherwise ship only the topology-consistency part (rs2 with linefit's own kernel, no new lambda), which adds no tuned parameter that could fail to transfer.
realistic_public_gain: About 0 to +0.001 public, which the LB cannot resolve (noise ~+-0.002), and only if the edge filter itself transfers. Private would be similar or slightly lower where the ILP re-links are less accurate out of sample. The local ceiling is +0.0025 overall and +0.0013 on 44b6. It is not a lever toward 0.97.
